description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Under Section 66 (C) Summon the Meeting to Dill the Vacancy Arose to the Post of Chairman of the Ninthavur Pradesiya Sabha
reasoning: The gazette content is a notice summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the post of Chairman of a specific Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority). It is issued under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act and pertains directly to an electoral process at the local government level. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes "Election announcements and schedules" and matters related to filling vacancies within elected bodies.
